title: Read the image notebook environment report
description: You inspect version information and an optional shell diagnostic.

steps.description: You define _sh to capture shell output as text and print it. Standard error joins standard output in the captured result.
You print Python, platform, and Colab information. The recording shows Python 3.12.16 on Linux with the Colab check False.

steps.question: What does _sh print when the recorded shell cannot find nvidia-smi?
steps.answer: It prints the captured nvidia-smi: not found diagnostic. The shell command includes || true, so it finishes with a successful status.

steps.description: You see the NVIDIA heading followed by the shell diagnostic. Those lines complete the supplied environment report.
